fix_code:
def main():
    N = int(input())
    S = input().strip()
    C = list(map(int, input().split()))
    
    min_cost = float('inf')
    
    for i in range(N - 1):
        if S[i] != S[i + 1]:
            cost_to_flip_i = C[i]
            cost_to_flip_i_plus_1 = C[i + 1]
            min_cost = min(min_cost, cost_to_flip_i, cost_to_flip_i_plus_1)
    
    print(min_cost)
